clue.text: Shoe style on many performers in London

indicators.note: in a down-or-across charade 'on' sets one piece next to the other, here the shoe followed by the troupe

parts.note: an Oxford is a classic laced leather shoe
a circus is a big company of acrobats, clowns and other performers

explanation.surface: A fashion note about footwear worn by a troupe of entertainers in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: 'in London' stands for a place found there. Oxford Circus is a busy London junction of Oxford Street and Regent Street, with a Tube station.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer names a well-known road junction and Underground station in the West End of the British capital.

clue.text: Instrument back in the middle of republican IRA conspiracy

indicators.note: back tells you to read the letters found in reverse order
the letters sit inside the run of words, spanning the end of one into the next

explanation.surface: A musician is found at the heart of a republican plot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the middle of' finds ANIRACO across 'republican IRA conspiracy'; 'back' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocarina is a small egg-shaped wind instrument with finger holes, often made of clay.

indicators.note: the word is held inside another as a prisoner is held in a cell, so look within the next word

explanation.surface: A life sentence is the fitting punishment for a lawbreaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A felon is a person convicted of a serious crime, so a criminal.

clue.text: She cavorted with spy in cyberspace while her husband had a close shave

definitions.text: She cavorted with spy in cyberspace while her husband had a close shave

indicators.note: cavorted suggests leaping about, so the letters jump into a new order

parts.note: taken as written: these letters plus the answer's make up the long word

explanation.surface: A woman has an online fling with a secret agent while her husband narrowly escapes danger.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite anagram: 'cavorted' says SHE (the answer) with SPY rearranges to CYBERSPACE, so cyberspace less S, P, Y gives the answer's letters. Biblical Rebecca married Isaac, who was nearly sacrificed by his father.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebecca was the wife of Isaac in Genesis, whose father Abraham came close to killing him on the altar.

clue.text: Ciabatta may be said to be exclusively family-made

indicators.note: said points to how the words sound when spoken rather than how they are spelt

parts.note: a ciabatta is a kind of Italian loaf, so it falls 'in bread' as a category

explanation.surface: A loaf can claim to be made only by one family's bakery.
explanation.walkthrough: Ciabatta belongs 'in bread', and that phrase spoken matches the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Inbred describes offspring produced by close relatives mating, so made only within the family line.

parts.note: a queen is a female cat
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the standard crossword queen

indicators.note: heard signals that the word is taken by its sound and given a different spelling

parts.note: the wall the cats sit on, spoken

explanation.surface: Female cats perched on a garden wall at night are heard making exactly this noise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queens' supplies two pieces: CAT (a female cat is a queen) and ER (Elizabeth Regina).
explanation.definitionFit: Caterwauling is the shrill wailing of cats, especially at mating time.

indicators.note: boxes means encloses, so the ointment word holds the other piece

parts.note: salve is a soothing ointment
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A tub of silver-based cream packed into containers.
explanation.walkthrough: '20' refers to the answer of 20 down, RESCUE, which is the definition here.
explanation.definitionFit: Salvage is the rescue of a ship or goods from loss, so a synonym of rescue.

clue.text: Chicken Shock picked up a prestigious award in America

indicators.note: picked up as in heard on a receiver, so the sound of the words counts

parts.note: a pullet is a young hen, and a shock is a surprise

explanation.surface: A scare involving poultry caught on a recording, oddly winning a major American honour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pullet surprise' is an old pun on the prize's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pulitzer is the most celebrated United States award for journalism, literature and music.

indicators.note: a voice over the telephone is heard rather than seen written

parts.note: a man is male

explanation.surface: A delivery worker making a phone call.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Postman' splits into the definition 'Post' and the piece 'man'.
explanation.definitionFit: Post and mail are interchangeable words for letters and parcels sent by the postal service.

parts.note: feeling down is feeling blue
bottle is British slang for nerve or courage

explanation.surface: Taking flight downward with bravery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fly' looks like a verb but names an insect. 'Bottle' for courage is British slang ('he lost his bottle').
explanation.definitionFit: A bluebottle is a large buzzing blowfly with a metallic blue body.

clue.text: Outdo "Vote for Clegg" on the radio

indicators.note: radio is heard, so the words count by their sound

parts.note: to vote for someone is to pick them, and Nick Clegg was the Liberal Democrat leader

explanation.surface: A political broadcast urging listeners to beat rivals by backing Nick Clegg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outdo' reads as 'out do', an outdoor function. Nick Clegg led the UK Liberal Democrats and was Deputy Prime Minister 2010-15.
explanation.definitionFit: A meal eaten outdoors is a social occasion held outside, a cryptic 'out do'.

clue.text: If cheese eating course routinely ends a meal, for starters offer something else

definitions.text: If cheese eating course routinely ends a meal, for starters offer something else

indicators.note: starters are the opening items, so take the opening letter of each word

explanation.surface: Dinner-party advice: if the cheese board always closes the meal, try serving a different dessert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for starters' takes the first letter of each of the eight words from 'If' to 'meal'; the whole clue then describes the answer as an alternative final course.
explanation.definitionFit: A frozen dairy dessert is the obvious different thing to serve at the end of dinner instead of cheese.

clue.text: One taking pictures of Daddy snoring in the middle of karaoke

parts.note: papa is a familiar word for father

indicators.note: in places the snoring sound inside the other piece
the central letters of the word are taken

parts.note: zz is the cartoon sound of someone asleep

explanation.surface: A photographer snapping a father dozing off during a karaoke night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the middle of' does double duty in the surface: 'the middle of' takes the central three letters of karaoke, and 'in' puts the snoring inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: A paparazzo is a freelance photographer who chases celebrities for candid shots.

clue.text: Sauna bath cures — all stripped naked

indicators.note: stripped means each word has its outer covering, its first and last letters, peeled away

explanation.surface: A sauna and bath cure every ill, and everyone in them is undressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stripped' removes the outside letters of each word: AUN, AT, URE, L.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means in a natural state, used in English for being unclothed.

clue.text: Some wind back through clear gap used at site of battle

indicators.note: through means one piece passes into the middle of the other
used here in the sense of worn or knocked about, so these letters are rearranged
back tells you to read that piece in reverse order

parts.note: a fart is a release of wind, and 'some' gives the article A

explanation.surface: A gust passing through an opening where a famous fight took place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some wind' is A FART; 'back' reverses it and 'through' runs it into the rearranged letters of 'clear gap' ('used' is the anagram signal) just after the first four.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish headland off which Nelson won the 1805 naval battle against the French and Spanish fleets.

indicators.note: after says the heather piece follows the others

parts.note: with is a synonym of the conjunction A N D, preceded by the letter on a hospital road sign, H
common heather, Calluna vulgaris, has a four-letter alternative name; the 's stands for 'is'

explanation.surface: A woman named Heather is discharged from hospital with her course of treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name but is the moorland plant, under its other name.
explanation.definitionFit: Handling is the way something or someone is dealt with or managed, so treatment.

parts.note: to hone a blade is to sharpen it
a sty is a pen for pigs

explanation.surface: Sharpening a writing instrument while keeping it level.
explanation.definitionFit: Being straight with people means being truthful, which is the quality of sincerity and candour.

indicators.note: holding means the word clasps the other piece inside it

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the piece reads from bottom to top

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland

explanation.surface: Protection gained by propping up a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is not a link word here: it is the container, taken as written, and 'up' turns the river, as fits a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Freedom from something, such as tax, is exemption from it, which is the sense of immunity.

parts.note: taken as written
Dante Alighieri wrote the Divine Comedy

explanation.surface: An Italian poet's slow, unhurried manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is only a link word joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Andante is a musical tempo marking meaning at a moderately slow walking pace.

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter, at regular intervals

parts.note: a cue is a prompt given to an actor

explanation.surface: The Greeks urgently need saving from their debt crisis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the second, fourth and sixth letters of Greeks, RES.
explanation.definitionFit: Rescue means being saved from danger, so deliverance or salvation.

clue.text: Anorak edges woven with winter clothing

indicators.note: woven means the letters are interlaced into a new pattern
edges are the outside letters of the word, first and last

explanation.surface: The trim of a coat stitched into some cold-weather garments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'edges' gives AK from Anorak; 'woven' rearranges AK with WINTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Knitwear is the collective term for jumpers, cardigans and other knitted garments.

clue.text: Be somebody, not so flipping Philistine

indicators.note: flipping means turning over, so this part of the word is turned round
not says the following word is left out of the long word

parts.note: taken as written
Philistine is the setter's pseudonym, and a setter refers to the setter as me

explanation.surface: An instruction to become an important person and stop being so uncultured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not so' removes SO from somebody, leaving MEBODY; 'flipping' turns the ME (the setter, Philistine) to EM.
explanation.definitionFit: To embody a quality is to be its living form, so the verb can stand for be.

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: the Baltic is a sea in northern Europe

explanation.surface: An unlimited supply of fish and shellfish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seafood' splits into 'sea' and the definition 'food'.
explanation.definitionFit: A balti is a spicy curry dish cooked and served in a wok-like pan.

indicators.note: ground as in crushed or milled, so the letters are broken up and reformed

explanation.surface: An actor in a Ground Zero film says they were shut out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ground Zero' looks like a single name, the site of the World Trade Center, but 'Ground' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To be ostracized is to be excluded from a group, as by exile.

indicators.note: hurt here means damaged, so the letters are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: Someone wept from being badly wounded.
explanation.definitionFit: To yelp is to give a sharp cry of pain, so a past-tense synonym for cried.

clue.text: Compiler likes men and women to live and drink

parts.note: the compiler would say I'm bisexual, shortened to I'm bi
to be is to exist or live

explanation.surface: The setter declares a broad love life and a taste for living and drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Imbibe means to take in liquid, especially alcohol, as with drinking.
